answer: Start with the precondition: fake work must be indistinguishable from none. So the network plants honeypot tasks whose answers the operator already knows. An agent that posts the planted answer without doing the task is marked. Attestations coming from one subnet get taxed, because one funder shows up as a flat signal along that thread. Every claim is then re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The nectar is paid only for labour that survived that check.
